segments.description: Designs and sells wireless transport solutions for short-haul, long-haul and small cells transport.
segments.evidence: Wireless Transport; Short-haul, Long-haul and Small Cells Transport

revenueModel.text: Mobile operators and telecommunications companies pay for wireless transport equipment and professional services for network deployment and maintenance.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from tangible products is recognized at a point in time when control of the product is transferred to the customer (i.e., when the Company's performance obligation is satisfied), in accordance with the agreed-upon delivery terms. Revenues from customer support and extended warranty are recognized ratably over the contract period, as the services have a consistent continuous pattern of transfer to a customer during the contract period.
